hooks.name: Git Safety Guardrails
hooks.description: Bloqueia comandos git destrutivos: push --force, reset --hard, rm -rf na raiz, push direto para main/master

action.command: powershell -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $input.tool_input.command; $blocked = @('push --force','push -f','reset --hard','clean -fd','clean -f','rm -rf','push origin master','push origin main'); foreach ($b in $blocked) { if ($cmd -match [regex]::Escape($b)) { Write-Error "BLOQUEADO: '$b' e uma operacao destrutiva. Use PR ou peca confirmacao explicita."; exit 2 } }; exit 0"
